messages.subject: Looking for Director Reserach, strong on QCA, willing to work in Addis, Ethiopia (up to 5 years)
parts:
Hi All,
I've worked for many years to get the US Goverment's USAID to take QCA further and these efforts are starting to pay off. Specifically, USAID would know like to embedd QCA as the main driver of adaptivement management of a very large household resileince project in the Highlands of Ethiopia. The project is for 5 years. We need a Director of Research and Learning who is strong in QCA to join our team on this opportunity.
The job description is here: https://jobs.socha.net/director-of-research-and-learning-ethiopia/
If you feel you meet the requirements, please apply as well as feel free to refer this opportunity to others who may be eligible.
Thank you,
Carroll Patterson, PhD
